messages:
Maya - Sales: quick heads-up, Acme POC blocked on SSO + SCIM during Dedicated onboarding. They can't sign in and SCIM groups never appear in our tenant. Customer is on Okta. Details in replies.
Alex - Eng Identity: can you paste the SAML response/assertion we got from their IdP (redacted)? need to see NameID/attributes.
Maya - Sales: pasted the response they emailed (redacted certs):
<samlp:Response>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <saml:Subject>
      <saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified">
      </saml:NameID>
    </saml:Subject>
    <saml:AttributeStatement>
      <saml:Attribute Name="mail">
        <saml:AttributeValue>alice@acme.example.com</saml:AttributeValue>
      </saml:Attribute>
    </saml:AttributeStatement>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
Maya - Sales: note: NameID is empty and NameID Format is 'unspecified' (their IdP default). Acme says they cannot change the IdP quickly.
Alex - Eng Identity: ok that explains the login fail — our default SAML flow requires NameID/email in the NameID element. We do have a fallback to attribute 'mail' but it's not triggering because our mapping expects NameID or attribute 'email'. Looks like they send 'mail' not 'email'.
Jamal - Eng Platform: SCIM side logs for group provisioning show repeated 409 -> conflicting path:
POST /scim/v2/Groups -> 201 then subsequent PATCH -> 409 Conflict
error: groupPath '/Engineering' vs expected 'Engineering' -> normalized check failed
Jamal - Eng Platform: their SCIM sends group displayName with leading slash in some flows. Our normalization rejects leading slash for tenant-level uniqueness. We can enable a tenant flag to strip leading slashes during normalization.
Katie - Security: security question from their infosec: what signing algorithm do we accept? they want RSA-SHA256 and certificate rotation policy documented. Also asking whether SCIM calls use mutual TLS or a bearer token.
Maya - Sales: Acme confirms IdP will only change attributes after a week. They need a short-term workaround so POC can continue this week. Also asking about Dedicated pool access: they say the provided API key got 403 when hitting the dedicated endpoint (pool id: ded-pool-231).
Alex - Eng Identity: short-term fix: add a mapping rule to treat empty NameID as fallback to attribute 'mail'. I'll prepare a small mapping patch and test in staging.
Jamal - Eng Platform: on SCIM, I'll flip tenant flag stripLeadingSlash=true for their tenant. That should let groups create. No downtime, just config. Will also check why our de-dupe treats '/X' and 'X' as different.
Katie - Security: for Dedicated API key 403 -> check ACLs and referer restrictions. If calls come from their cloud vpc, check egress IP allowlist in the Dedicated control plane. Also we require TLS1.2+ and token auth for SCIM by default; we offer mTLS as an enterprise option.
Maya - Sales: action items: Alex -> push mapping to staging and share patch. Jamal -> enable stripLeadingSlash on tenant and validate SCIM create. Katie -> confirm signing alg acceptance and provide doc link for rotation. I'll coordinate with Acme and schedule a quick call. ETA 24h on all.
Alex - Eng Identity: patch uploaded to staging, config id: cfg-1182. Test plan: 1) replay SAML response with NameID empty + mail attribute, 2) verify login and session creation, 3) ensure audit log shows subject=alice@acme.example.com.
deploy-bot: scheduled config rollout cfg-1182 -> staging at 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z, no downtime expected.
Jamal - Eng Platform: stripLeadingSlash set for tenant acme-2026 (flag id: tn-431). Triggered a one-time reconciliation to create missing groups. Reconcile log: 6 groups created, 2 updated.
Katie - Security: shared doc link (internal): https://redwood.internal/security/saml-hardening. Also confirmed we accept RSA-SHA256; we can accept SHA1 for compatibility but recommend refuse - Acme to confirm.
Maya - Sales: Acme confirmed they can adjust to mail->email mapping on their side in 7 days; but for the demo tomorrow the staging patch + SCIM flag fixes the blocker. Setting up 10:00am PST debug call tomorrow with Alex and Jamal. :thumbsup: 
Alex - Eng Identity: noted, will be available.
Jamal - Eng Platform: noted. Will monitor logs during demo.
Maya - Sales: closing loop here, I'll post updates after the call.
